name: Northern Singlespike Sedge
desc: Northern Singlespike Sedge (Carex scirpoidea): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 12 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Carex scirpoidea is a species of sedge belonging to the family Cyperaceae. It is dioecious, with male and female flowers on separate plants.
